zh-CN.title: 全站选择操作更统一
items: 下拉框统一为带右箭头的操作栏，点击后在模态框中选择
长候选列表支持搜索，保留当前选项标记与键盘操作
同步统一菜单、科研、投稿筛选及管理面板，适配横竖屏和深色模式

en.title: Consistent selection controls throughout the app
items: Dropdowns become action rows with right arrows and modal option lists
Search long lists with current-selection indicators and keyboard navigation
Unified menus, research, submission filters and management controls across screen sizes and themes
